issue.title: Template validation error: Template format error: Unresolved resource dependencies [xxxxx] in the Resources block of the template

system_prompt: You are a helpful AI assistant who classifies GitHub issues according to predefined categories. Your goal is to determine if the GitHub issue can be reproduced to verify the provided solution's correctness.
llm_response:
I'll analyze this GitHub issue to determine if a build environment is needed to verify the solution.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is a CloudFormation template validation error that can be analyzed without a build environment. The error message indicates "Unresolved resource dependencies" in the template. Looking at the code, I can identify the issue: there's a case sensitivity problem in the template. In the "RDSSubnetARouteTableAssociation" and "RDSSubnetBRouteTableAssociation" resources, the reference to "RouteTable" is incorrectly written as "Routetable" (with a lowercase 't'). CloudFormation references are case-sensitive, so this mismatch causes the unresolved dependency error. This type of issue can be verified through simple code analysis without needing to build or run any code. The solution would be to correct the case to match the actual resource name "RouteTable" in both places. Additionally, there's a typo in the VPC properties where "EnableDnsHostnames" is set to "ture" instead of "true", which could also cause validation issues. These problems can be identified and verified through static analysis of the template.
